headline: US stocks rallied sharply on Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia, but bitcoin gave back its early jump and ended Monday roughly flat near $61,000, with a Fed rate hike still expected in December.

market.asOf: Read about 23:55-00:00 UTC Mon 23 Nov (6:55pm ET; 06:55 Tue Bangkok). BTC from The Motley Fool's early-evening ET reading; ETH and SOL from CoinMarketCap. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 9 out of 100 on CoinMarketCap's Crypto Fear and Greed Index, read about 00:00 UTC Tue 24 Nov.

stories.title: Wall Street has a historic rally on Nvidia's CEO news, and bitcoin sits it out
stories.summary: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO and US stocks soared on Monday. Bitcoin jumped early in the day but could not hold it and finished the US session roughly where it started. Traders said the jump was short sellers being forced out, not new buyers.
points: The Dow closed up 1,147 points (3.0%), the S&P 500 rose 4.7% and the Nasdaq 6.5%; Nvidia shares closed up more than 31%, per ABC News.
Bitcoin reached $64,603 on Monday before falling back toward $61,500, per crypto.news.
By early evening ET bitcoin was about $61,213, up only 0.08% on the day, per The Motley Fool.
"Short squeeze ended and no spot bid during the market open to sustain price," one trader told crypto.news.
Over the weekend bitcoin fell to $55,106, 37% below its September peak, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: Fed's Williams keeps a rate hike on the table as money leaves bitcoin funds
stories.summary: New York Fed President John Williams said on Monday that the Fed needs to do more to bring inflation down, and would not rule out hikes at back-to-back meetings. Traders already expect a December hike. Meanwhile US spot bitcoin funds keep losing money, and October inflation data lands on Wednesday.
points: Williams said "further action is necessary" to get inflation back to 2%, per KuCoin, but "I don't think the situation calls for dramatic action," per AOL.
"I'm not excluding options," Williams said after his speech, adding that he would not rule out moving at back-to-back meetings if needed, per investingLive.
More than 95% of traders expected a quarter-point hike in December, per CoinDesk's week-ahead report on 23 Nov.
US spot bitcoin funds lost $1.79 billion in the week to 20 Nov, and $4.137 billion over 15 trading days, per crypto.news.
October PCE inflation is out Wed 25 Nov at 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok); see the calendar below.

stories.title: US moves to seize $1.17 billion in USDC from the Binance hack
stories.summary: The Justice Department asked a court to hand over USDC stablecoins traced to last month's Binance hack. Circle has frozen the coins and says it will issue fresh USDC of the same amount once a court orders the forfeiture.
points: The civil forfeiture complaint covers about $1.17 billion in USDC across 36 addresses on 18 blockchains, per The Block.
US officials attribute the 29 Oct hack to North Korea's Lazarus Group, per The Block.
Binance put its losses at about $6.34 billion and says it fully replenished user assets, per The Block.
Circle cannot move the frozen tokens, so it agreed to issue new USDC equal to the seized amount after a court order, per The Block.

briefs.title: Kalshi keeps operating in New York for now
briefs.summary: Justice Melissa Crane denied the Attorney General's request for a temporary restraining order and offered 7 or 8 Jan for a fuller hearing; the two sides must agree safeguards for 18-to-20-year-old sports traders by 30 Nov, per Forbes.

briefs.title: Monad's large MON unlock is today
briefs.summary: About 16.6 billion MON unlock on 24 Nov, mostly to the team and investors. Trackers disagree on the size because Monad never published the exact cliff amounts, per Kommunitas. See the unlock table on this page for this desk's size and confidence.

briefs.title: Strategy buys 457 more bitcoin
briefs.summary: The company bought 457 BTC for $29.6 million from 16 to 22 Nov, taking it to 851,305 BTC, and raised its buyback authorization to $4 billion, per The Crypto Basic.

briefs.title: US business activity growth slows to a four-month low
briefs.summary: S&P Global's flash composite PMI fell to 54.6 in November from 55.9, with services at 54.7, per QNC News.

briefs.title: Bitmine adds more ether
briefs.summary: Bitmine added 7,819 ETH, bringing its holdings to 6,085,564 ETH as of 22 Nov, per The Crypto Basic.

briefs.title: Chainflip's bounty deadline has passed
briefs.summary: Chainflip offered the hacker a 10% bounty to return the rest of about $12 million stolen, with a deadline of 18:38 UTC Mon 23 Nov; no outcome has been reported, per Cryptonomist.
